questions.question: True or False: Petr Čech holds the record for the most clean sheets in Premier League history, recording 202 clean sheets.
questions.anchorClues: Petr Čech kept 202 clean sheets in 443 Premier League appearances across his spells at Chelsea and Arsenal.

questions.question: Which player scored the fastest goal in Premier League history, finding the net after just 7.69 seconds?
questions.anchorClues: Shane Long scored for Southampton against Watford on 23 April 2019 in just 7.69 seconds from kick-off.

questions.question: Which manager won the most Premier League Manager of the Month awards during his career, claiming the award 27 times?
questions.anchorClues: Sir Alex Ferguson won 27 Manager of the Month awards during his tenure at Manchester United, comfortably clear at the top.

questions.question: Who holds the all-time record for the most Premier League assists, setting the benchmark with 162 assists?
questions.anchorClues: Ryan Giggs registered 162 assists across 21 Premier League seasons with Manchester United.

questions.question: Who was the first player in Premier League history to score five goals in a single match?
questions.anchorClues: Andrew Cole scored five goals for Manchester United in a 9–0 win over Ipswich Town at Old Trafford on 4 March 1995.

questions.question: Who holds the all-time record for the most penalty goals scored in Premier League history, converting 56 spot-kicks?
questions.anchorClues: Alan Shearer scored 56 penalties in the Premier League for Blackburn Rovers and Newcastle United, six more than Frank Lampard.

questions.question: Which club holds the record for the longest unbeaten home run in Premier League history, going 86 consecutive matches without defeat?
questions.anchorClues: Chelsea remained undefeated at Stamford Bridge across 86 consecutive Premier League matches between March 2004 and October 2008.

questions.question: Who scored the first-ever Premier League hat-trick, doing so in August 1992?
questions.anchorClues: Éric Cantona scored the competition's first hat-trick for Leeds United in a 5–0 victory over Tottenham Hotspur on 25 August 1992.

questions.question: Which player holds the all-time Premier League record for the most direct free-kick goals scored, with 18?
questions.anchorClues: David Beckham scored 18 direct free-kicks during his Premier League career for Manchester United.

questions.question: Which player holds the Premier League record for scoring against the most different opponent clubs, netting against 39 teams?
questions.anchorClues: Frank Lampard scored against 39 distinct Premier League clubs during his career with West Ham United, Chelsea, and Manchester City.
